q: Quantum entanglement distillation converts n copies of a partially entangled state ρ into m copies of a maximally entangled state (EPR pair) using only LOCC. The asymptotic rate m/n is bounded by the:
opts: Distillable entanglement E_D(ρ) = lim_{n→∞} max_{LOCC} m/n
exp: Distillable entanglement E_D(ρ) = sup{r : LOCC on ρ^⊗n → approximately r·n EPR pairs}. For pure states, E_D = S(ρ_A) = entanglement entropy. For mixed states, E_D ≤ E_F (entanglement of formation) and may be strictly less (bound entangled states have E_D = 0 but E_F > 0).
